The attack reportedly occurred at about midnight yesterday, 4th November, 2026, when the locals were sleeping in their homes.
The unfortunate development has heightened concerns over the worsening security situation in the state.
Neither the Kaduna State Police Command nor the Ministry for Internal Security and Home Affairs have made any public statements on the development as of the time of filing this report.
But a credible source who spoke in confidence confirmed the incident, saying, “Kidnappers entered Akwando village, Kuturmi land in Kachia LGA, Kaduna State, at 12 a.m. yesterday, killed two and kidnapped 21 persons.
“Members of the affected community are still apprehensive over the incidents. “As we speak, the bandits have not made any demand.”
